meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能用Benchling官方Python库操作实验室数据：创建/更新DNA、RNA、蛋白质序列，管理库存样品，创建实验记录，处理工作流，查询数据仓库。它会写Python代码并执行。
howto.when: 当你要求用Benchling Python库或API自动化实验室数据时触发，例如管理基因序列、操作库存、创建实验记录等。

say.text: 创建DNA序列“质粒A”，碱基ATCGATCG，存到fld_abc123。
say.note: Claude会创建序列并返回结果。
Claude会执行库存转移并确认。

say.text: 从数据仓库查询上月实验结果数量。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the official Benchling Python library to manage lab data: create/update DNA, RNA, protein sequences, manage inventory, create ELN entries, handle workflows, query data warehouse. It writes and runs Python code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to automate lab data with the Benchling Python SDK or API, e.g., managing sequences, inventory, or ELN entries.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence 'Plasmid A' with bases ATCGATCG in folder fld_abc123.
say_en.note: Claude creates the sequence and returns the result.
Claude performs the transfer and confirms.

say_en.text: Query the data warehouse for last month's experiment count.
